storyCards.headline: The Other Woman: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Ray Parker Jr's "The Other Woman" reached #4 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #4 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 21 weeks on the chart.

The Other Woman was released in 1982.

Chart story — peaked at #4 on the Hot 100.
